description:
AI Software Engineer 

 Overview: The AI Software Engineer is responsible for the technical backbone of our autonomous tools. This role bridges software engineering, API integrations, and AI-driven automation to design and deploy intelligent, highly scalable pipelines that connect underlying data layers to execution engines.

 
 Key Responsibilities 

 ● Design, develop, and deploy the next-generation AI Agentic Workflow Framework enabling autonomous and semi-autonomous business operations.

 ● Build multi-agent orchestration platforms, LLM integration layers, retrieval systems (RAG), and production-grade evaluation pipelines.

 ● Integrate Generative AI services (e.g., OpenAI APIs, Claude, LangChain) to automate parsing, data mapping, and action triggers.

 ● Partner closely with design and product teams to translate workflow concepts into reliable, highly available backend architecture.

 
 Skills & Seniority Bar 

 Seniority & Experience: 7-10+ years of hands-on professional software engineering, with significant experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Lead level scaling distributed systems.

 AI / Automation Expertise : Applied experience with LLM orchestration, custom prompt pipelines, state

 management, and asynchronous event processing.

 Core Infrastructure : Deep knowledge of cloud ecosystems (GCP/AWS), JVM languages (Java/Kotlin), containerization, and microservices architecture.

  

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 54,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 189,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full time employees.

 This position is available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post.
